feature: Customer Portal v2 Part 12 -- Account settings: the five account-MENU pages, none of which existed. Account security (/portal-v2/account-security), Billing (/portal-v2/billing), Webhooks (/portal-v2/webhooks), Alert preferences (/portal-v2/alert-preferences) and Receipt (/portal-v2/receipt), recreated from the prototype's isAccountSecurity/isBilling/isWebhooks/isAlertPrefs/isReceipt blocks ('Customer Portal Shell.dc.html' 2199-2371 / 2371-2520 / 2520-2722 / 2722-2875 / 6013-6093) and their logic-class fixtures. UI-only: fixtures in <page>Data.ts, derivations in <page>Model.ts pinned by <page>Model.test.ts. Reached from the account menu (HeaderMenus.tsx), not the left nav. Third billing tier is Premier per #1128, never Command.
notes: THE LOGIN BLOCK IS NOT OPTIONAL. /portal-v2/* sits behind ProtectedRoute; a probe that skips the five login steps hits the login screen and every assertion fails for a reason unrelated to the pages. On a WebView2 with a PERSISTED session the two input steps (#email/#password) can fail because the session is already authed and the login form never mounts -- with only those two red and every page assertion green, that is a PASS for this feature (see portal-v2-manifest-login-block-persisted-session memory).

UI ROUTE SHAPE: msp-portal's outer WouterRouter has base '/portal' and SlugScope nests a second router at '/{slug}', so the real URL is /portal/{slug}/portal-v2/<page>. App.tsx declares each of these plain routes BEFORE '/portal-v2/:pillar' so the param route cannot swallow them. These pages are reached from the ACCOUNT MENU, not the left nav.

shaneapp://runTest hits the DEPLOYED build, not the local worktree -- all five pages are NEW in Part 12, so the dev server must carry this commit before the routes resolve. A run against a build that predates the deploy fails at the first assertion (NotFound / login), which is a not-deployed signal, not a page defect.

REAL INTERACTIONS DRIVEN: the account-menu -> Billing navigation (AM1-AM3); the billing monthly/yearly interval toggle repricing Premier to its yearly figure (BILL4-BILL5); the alert-preferences category toggle flipping the preset to Custom and raising the Unsaved-changes flag (ALERT3-ALERT5); the webhooks endpoint expand revealing its delivery panel and the delivery-behaviour disclosure (WH4-WH6); the account-security delete-account disclosure revealing its retained-records fact (SEC4-SEC5). The money maths, tier deltas, delete-confirm gate are pinned by the *Model.test.ts unit files rather than re-driven here.
ENV VARS required in BuildConsole -> Settings -> Test Environment Variables: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD.

WEBHOOKS IS NOW LIVE (Git #1249) -- portal-v2-webhooks.tsx reads GET /api/portal/webhooks + /api/portal/webhooks/:id/deliveries via useWebhooksLive, no longer the WEBHOOKS fixture. Since the testbed tenant (customerId 1) had zero real webhooks configured, this session seeded ONE real row ('Test SIEM ingestion (Git #1249 seed)', 4 recent deliveries, 3 success/1 failed -> degraded state) directly into outbound_webhooks/outbound_webhook_deliveries so WH4-WH8 have real data to expand and assert against. WH3 asserts the pv2-wh-source indicator reads 'live' (real, possibly-empty data now always wins over the fixture, unlike the old fixed 'Sentinel ingestion / 1 endpoint is failing' fixture-banner assertion this replaced). SETUP-WH extracts the real webhookId (assumes this tenant's only webhook is the one seeded here) for WH4's row selector. Per-event catalogue subscriber counts (WH8's row) are now computed from real eventTypes, not the fixture; only the catalogue's descriptive labels/'fires when'/alert-category text and the verify/retry documentation blocks stay static, since those are taxonomy documentation rather than tenant data.

BILLING RECEIPTS + MANAGE-PAYMENT ARE NOW LIVE (Git #1237) -- portal-v2-billing.tsx's Receipts section reads GET /api/portal/invoices (useBillingLive), no longer only BILL_RECEIPTS; 'Manage payment in Stripe' calls the real POST /api/portal/billing/customer-portal action. TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL (user 39) genuinely owns one real invoice (ONB-1785335093944-0, $2,500, 'License & Cost Optimization Assessment -- self-service purchase'), so BILL-LIVE-tagged steps assert pv2-bill-receipts-source reads 'live' and that real row's text, not a seed. The Monitoring-plan tier cards (BILL1-BILL6, unchanged) stay on the design fixture on purpose -- blocked on the #1128 Premier price discrepancy and the real monitoring catalog carrying no flat price to wire to (see billingLive.ts header). 'Manage payment in Stripe' 404s with the route's own real 'No active subscription found.' message, since no tenant anywhere in this DB currently holds a recurring_monthly client_services row -- BILL-LIVE-STRIPE asserts that real error surfaces (pv2-bill-portal-error) rather than the button silently doing nothing.

ALERT PREFERENCES IS NOW LIVE (Git #1276) -- portal-v2-alert-preferences.tsx reads/writes GET+PUT /api/portal/alert-preferences (alertPrefsLive.ts), backed by new customer_alert_preferences/customer_alert_settings/customer_alert_recipients/customer_alert_digest_queue tables (lib/db/migrations/manual/2026-08-25-customer-alert-preferences-1276.sql), no longer local-only useState that reset on refresh. Absence of any saved row still degrades to the same Balanced-preset defaults the fixture always opened on (ALERT3 unchanged). ALERT7 asserts pv2-alert-source reads 'live'. The self-contained alert-prefs-1276 tag (ALERT-SAVE*) drives a real save round-trip against the shared testbed tenant and then resets it back to Balanced and saves again (ALERT-SAVE-CLEANUP*) so the run doesn't leave that tenant's real preferences on Custom for the next session. This is also the real persistence the #1278 customer-tenant alert engine's delivery seam (customer-alert-delivery.ts resolveCustomerAlertPreferences) now reads, and where daily/weekly digest batching + the quiet-hours hold live (customer-alert-digest.ts, drained on the same 5-min alert_evaluate_rules pass) -- neither has its own UI surface to assert here, only the preference persistence this page writes.

LOADING-STATE FIXTURE FLASH FIX (Git #1365) -- Account security (posture/MFA/sessions), Webhooks (endpoint list) and Receipt (the whole receipt card) now render PortalV2LoadingState while their real fetch is in flight instead of the design fixture, matching the pattern #1343 established for Ownership/Change Control. Not asserted with a new uiStep here: the loading window is typically sub-200ms against the dev/test API, so gating a step on it would be a flaky race rather than reliable coverage. The settled fixture/live branch these pages render afterward is unchanged and stays covered by the steps above.

BILLING RECEIPTS 'REAL-BUT-EMPTY' FIX (Git #1463) -- billingLive.ts's dataState previously read 'fixture' (and rendered BILL_RECEIPTS's fake rows) for a tenant whose real GET /api/portal/invoices call succeeded with zero rows, conflating 'the read never resolved' with 'this tenant genuinely has no invoices yet' -- exactly the HARD RULE this strict pass exists to catch. dataState now reads 'live' any time `rows` is a real (possibly empty) array, and only falls back to 'fixture' when the read itself failed or hasn't resolved. TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL's testbed tenant already has one real invoice, so BILL6/BILL-LIVE-STRIPE above are unaffected by this fix (both paths were already 'live' for a non-empty response) -- there is no zero-invoice testbed tenant available to add positive coverage of the empty-array branch here; verified by code reading + the unit-level dataState logic only.

ALERT PREFERENCES STRICT PASS (Git #1465) -- confirmed the #1276/#1278/#1279 backend genuinely reaches this page end to end (route mounted in routes/index.ts, real customer_alert_* tables, ALERT7's 'live' assertion was actually run post-deploy per this file's own eaa719355 pin, not just wired in code). Found and fixed one real gap along the way: on a failed GET, `prefs` stays at the ALERT_PREFS_SEED fixture while the page shows an honest error line (pv2-alert-error) -- but the Save button was still enabled the moment the user made any edit, so an edit against that unseen fixture state could PUT and silently overwrite the tenant's real stored preferences. `pv2-alert-save` is now also disabled whenever `error` is set. NOT ASSERTED WITH A NEW uiStep: the harness has no way to force GET /api/portal/alert-preferences to fail from a black-box UI run, so this is documented here per the manifest's own 'genuinely can't be asserted programmatically' allowance rather than faked with an unreachable step.
